onsite_generation: Claimed mix of on-site/dedicated wind, wave (CorPower Ocean array off the west coast near Islay — 600 MW pre-FEED, 2 GW ambition), solar, biogas/waste-to-energy (per Aug 2025 press), with vanadium-flow battery storage (Invinity) and a private-wire network enabling 'island mode'
demand_flexibility: Microgrid with grid-balancing and use of curtailed renewables claimed
methodology: Marketing/bid statements; no energy model, PPA or consent for any generation asset published. Target power price stated at ~£0.05/kWh.
notes: The dedicated wave array central to the 100% renewable claim relies on pre-commercial technology (CorPower C4 at pre-FEED/FEED stage) and would itself require marine licensing not yet applied for. SambaNova SN40L systems claimed to use ~one-tenth the power of GPU systems, air-cooled (no liquid cooling).
